GetUnlockedCards is the full unlocked pool and the sim assumes full unlocks for the non-ascension Ironclad (cards/pool.py:120-133 documents that), and CardMultiplayerConstraint is out of scope. guards.what: N2: the sim ADDS `has_upon_pickup_effect = True` (dusty_tome.py:20) where DustyTome.cs declares no HasUponPickupEffect override
guards.issue: MECHANISM: RelicModel.HasUponPickupEffect defaults to false and DustyTome does not override it -- contrast DistinguishedCape.cs:19 and DollysMirror.cs:14 in this same batch, which do. The sim sets it True. The flag is not decorative: relics/base.py:126-136's is_tradable returns False for any relic with an upon-pickup effect, so the sim refuses to let the Tome be traded where the game allows it. DORMANT, because the same predicate already excludes RelicRarity.ANCIENT (relics/base.py:134-136) and the Tome is Ancient, so is_tradable is False either way and the added flag changes nothing observable today. What would make it live: any use of has_upon_pickup_effect that is not also rarity-gated -- the C# flag additionally drives whether a relic can be offered by sources that must not re-run a pickup effect. Recorded rather than skipped because it is an ADDED declaration, the direction an audit is least likely to look, and because the sibling relics in this batch prove the source is deliberate about the flag.
